blocks.text: 20vin sadi ke shuru mein Darwinism ko jadeed genetics se mila kar Neo-Darwinism banaya gaya. Neo-Darwinism mein evolution ki zyada durust tareef 'aabadi mein alleles ki shareh, ya aabadi ki kul genetic banawat (gene pool), mein tabdeeli' hai. Neo-Darwinism Hardy-Weinberg theorem par qaim hai.

blocks.title: Maloomat: gene pool aur shareh
blocks.text: Gene pool: aabadi mein kisi khasiyat ke sab genes; maslan phool ke rang ke 1000 genes. Allele ki shareh: kisi khaas allele ka tanasub; agar 1000 mein 600 surkh ke hon to surkh ki shareh 0.6 (60%). Genotype ki shareh: kisi genotype wale afraad ka tanasub; agar 100 mein 40 paude RR hon to RR ki shareh 0.4 (40%).

1908 mein English riyazidaan Godfrey Hardy aur German tabeeb Wilhelm Weinberg ne kaha ke bari, ittefaqan milap karne wali aabadi mein agar koi irtiqai quwwat amal na kare to alleles aur genotypes ki shareh nasl dar nasl aik jaisi rehti hai. Agar neeche ki koi shart poori na ho to evolution hota hai.

items: Milap ittefaqi ho: har fard ka har doosre se milap ka barabar imkaan ho.
Koi fard aabadi mein aaye ya jaye nahi.
Mutations na hon, ya wild-type se mutant aur mutant se wapas wild-type mutations barabar hon.
Sab genotypes ka zinda rehne aur nasl barhane ka barabar imkaan ho.

blocks.text: Alleles ki shareh badalne wale awamil

Genetic drift: ittefaqi waqiyat, fitness nahi, genes ki shareh badalte hain, aur asar chhoti aabadiyon mein sab se wazeh hai; kitab ise neutral selection bhi kehti hai. Maslan aag 100 khargoshon ki aabadi ko 10 tak ghata deti hai aur bache hue ittefaqan zyada tar bhoore hain, is liye nayi aabadi ka genetic tanawwu kam hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: 100 khargoshon ki aabadi, aadhe bhoore aadhe safaid. Aag likha teer daen taraf: 10 bache hue, nau bhoore aur aik safaid. Note kehta hai ke tabdeeli ittefaqan hui, is liye nahi ke bhoore khargosh behtar dhale hue the.
blocks.caption: Aag ke baad genetic drift (kitab ki misaal ka asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Genetic drift alleles ki shareh mein aisi tabdeeli hai jo fitness ke bajaye ittefaqi waqiyat se hoti hai, aur chhoti aabadiyon mein sab se wazeh hoti hai. Kitab ki misaal mein aag 100 khargoshon ki aabadi ko 10 tak ghata deti hai; bache hue ittefaqan zyada tar bhoore hain, is liye nahi ke bhoore behtar dhale the, is liye nayi aabadi mein alleles ki shareh badal jati aur genetic tanawwu kam ho jata hai.

items: Gene flow: afraad ka aabadi mein aana (immigration) ya jana (emigration) us ke genes ki shareh badalta hai; aane wale foran naye alleles la sakte hain.

Mutation: mutations sab naye genes ka asal aur aise farq ka zariya hain jo faidamand ho sakte aur groups ko mahol ke jhatkon mein bachne mein madad dete hain. Zyada tar nuqsandeh hain; kuch bay-asar, ya aik mahol mein nuqsandeh aur doosre mein mufeed. Mutational equilibrium, jab aage aur wapas ki mutations barabar hon, kam hi hota hai; mutation pressure mutation se genes ki shareh badalne ke rujhan ka paimana hai.

blocks.prompt: Phool ke rang ke 1000 genes mein 300 safaid ke hain. Safaid allele ki shareh kya hai?

items: Neo-Darwinism: evolution = gene pool mein alleles ki shareh ki tabdeeli.
Hardy-Weinberg: bari, ittefaqi milap wali aabadi mein, baghair hijrat, mutation ya selection, shareh aik jaisi.
Drift, gene flow aur mutation alleles ki shareh badalte hain.
